correctness.rationale: The disk-automorphism unitary takes the three same-point jet functionals to the first three Taylor coefficients. The exact coefficient calculation yields a positive projection fraction and a derivative factoring as minus Q2 times Q3. Shifted-Jacobi orthogonality and strict Christoffel endpoint interlacing give exactly five simple critical points, hence three maxima. The finite candidate-set asymptotic follows by Jacobi-to-Laguerre convergence of all cubic roots, not finite scans. At beta 2, exact rational root brackets and exponential Taylor remainder isolate the three Gamma heights; as beta grows, a Gaussian/Hermite limit makes the middle peak strictly dominant since exp(3/2)>4. Continuity forces ties. Replaying standalone checker.py gives 98 finite exact rational assertions: polynomial identities, independent jet-Gram inverse projections and Gamma intervals; the infinite proof is analytic.

value.rationale: Choosing where to sample a high-degree weighted Bergman monomial using value, slope and curvature is a natural structured approximation problem. The theorem resolves its entire finite-degree landscape and gives a sharp asymptotic capture constant, with a qualitative change of optimal radius as the weight varies. The three-way comparison is not a mere scalar substitution from the known first-jet result; the new transition is a distinct phenomenon relevant to optimal jet sensor placement.
